sentences.text:
No. NOTE 01. 10.04.2025 HN, J  The learned counsel appearing for the  petitioner/accused submits that the petitioners  are arraigned as an accused Nos.1 to 4 in  Cr.No.202 of 2023 on the file of Vetapalem  Police Station, Bapatla for the alleged offence  under Sections 405, 406, 409, 415, 418, 420,
425, 468, 469, 471, 501, 120 (b) IPC r/w 156 (3)
Cr.P.C.
 It is submitted that the 2nd respondent has filed a private complaint and got the matter referred to the police for registration of a crime and investigation.

It is submitted that the 2nd respondent was working as lecture in C.R College,
Chilakaluripeta and the petitioners were his colleges.

It is submitted that the 2nd respondent alleged that the petitioners have not submitted his service record and also not maintained service record properly and also alleged that the petitioners have fabricated his service record.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits ..Cont..
that the service matter of the 2nd respondent is now converted into the criminal case.
The 2nd respondent has filed W.P.No.2083 of 2025 seeking service benefits for the service rendered by him at C.R College, Chilakarieta.
The 2nd respondent cannot maintain the private complaint against the petitioners and the petitioners have nothing to do with the service records of the 2nd respondent.
Considering the same, there shall be stay of all further proceedings in Cr.No.202 of 2023 on the file of Vetapalem Police Station.
The learned counsel for the petitioners is permitted to take out personal notice to the 2nd respondent through registered post with acknowledgment due and file proof of service in the Registry.
